404 Not Found when retrieving a nonexistent file

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm import Error, NotFoundError

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
        file_id = "file-nonexistent"
        await client.retrieve_file(file_id)
    except NotFoundError as error:
        print(f"NotFoundError: {error}")
    except Error as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
